    static int[][] dis = new int[12][12], tim = new int[12][12];

        boolean bfs() {

                    if (d[v] == -1 && cap[i] > flow[i]) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;

        int dfs(int u, int a) {
            if (u == t || a == 0)

    static boolean inRange(int x, int y) {
